note: B23 La Route & garage auto on the Carrefour des Voyages, camera on the cobbles of the square facing east. Same building as in the square view: honey-cream rough stone, terracotta tile roof (two skylights for the upstairs driving-school loft), weathered brown plank barn doors standing open, red vintage petrol pump with a round clock top, cream 1930s saloon car on the cobbles, the tyre planter of red geraniums. Whimsy: chimney shaped like a giant spark plug. Through the doors: the workshop with the little cream car up on the lift (R_road_03 landmark). Exits: barn doors -> R_road_03 L'atelier; fountain rim near left -> S08_sector. Number plates blanked (no painted text). Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08p4).
